course_description: This course examines how we can use psychology to help people achieve their full potential. The course examines how to develop skills and expertise in high stakes environments, how to help experts make better decisions, how to motivate people, and how to manage the impacts of stress, workload and fatigue on performance.

course_aims: The aim of this course is to develop your understanding of the psychological determinants of elite and expert performance, and how they can be used to improve performance in business and organisational settings.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply key concepts and principles from performance psychology to analyse and improve performance in real-world settings.
Critically evaluate research, including research designs used in applied contexts of performance psychology.
Communicate evidence-based arguments and recommendations for performance improvements to a business audience.
Apply motivational interviewing techniques and coaching frameworks in the conduct of a coaching conversation.
Diagnose performance issues, and design and evaluate interventions to address them.
Develop analytical skills to collect, analyse and interpret psychological data, including simple between-group comparisons such as t-tests and ANOVA.
Work collaboratively as part of a team to use evidence-based strategies to resolve complex real-world challenges in the field of performance psychology.
